summary: Aptevo Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce new clinical results from its RAINIER frontline AML trial. The filing reports an 87% clinical benefit rate and 81% remission rate across 31 evaluable patients treated with mipletamig plus venetoclax and azacitidine. The Phase 1b dose-optimization trial is on track to complete this year with Phase 2 dose selection. No deal terms, board actions, advisor names, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is a routine clinical update that does not constitute a special situation. Investors should focus on upcoming Phase 2 regulatory interactions.
